activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: The green coat is cheaper than the black coat. The black coat is ___ the green coat. (EXPENSIVE)
activities.explanation: The opposite comparison uses «more expensive than».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: Someone washes the uniforms every Friday. The uniforms are ___ every Friday. (WASHED)
activities.explanation: The passive phrase is «are washed».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: “I am late,” Kim said. Kim said that she was ___. (LATE)
activities.explanation: The adjective remains «late» while the reporting clause changes the pronoun and verb.

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: I began this job in April. I have worked here ___ April. (SINCE)
activities.explanation: A starting month is introduced with «since».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: The table is too narrow for four plates. The table is not ___ for four plates. (WIDE)
activities.explanation: The equivalent form is «not wide enough».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: The metro is faster than the tram. The tram is not ___ the metro. (FAST)
activities.explanation: The reverse comparison is «not as fast as».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: They painted the hall last weekend. The hall was ___ last weekend. (PAINTED)
activities.explanation: The past passive is «was painted».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: “I will email you,” Max said. Max said that he would email ___. (ME)
activities.explanation: The original «you» refers to the reporter, so it becomes «me».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: I last saw the play in May. I have not seen it ___ May. (SINCE)
activities.explanation: The last occurrence gives the starting point «since May».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: The suitcase is too heavy for the shelf. The shelf is not ___ for the suitcase. (STRONG)
activities.explanation: The equivalent ability is expressed with «not strong enough».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: People say that the park is safe at night. The park is ___ safe at night. (SAID)
activities.explanation: The reporting passive is «is said to be safe».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: The silver path is less steep than the red path. The red path is not ___ the silver path. (EASY)
activities.explanation: A less steep path is easier, so the reverse is «not as easy as».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: The company has installed new lights. New lights have ___ by the company. (INSTALLED)
activities.explanation: The present perfect passive uses «have been installed».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: “I can cover the afternoon shift,” Luis told Sara. Luis told Sara that he could cover ___. (SHIFT)
activities.explanation: The noun phrase stays the same while «can» changes to «could».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: I began studying at this college last September. I have studied here ___ September. (SINCE)
activities.explanation: The starting month is introduced with «since September».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: The wind was so strong that the boats stayed in harbour. The wind was ___ for the boats to leave. (TOO)
activities.explanation: The cause of the result is expressed as «too strong for the boats to leave».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: The chef prepared the meal. The meal was ___ the chef. (BY)
activities.explanation: The agent in a passive sentence is introduced by «by».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: “I have completed the form,” Mira said. Mira said that she had ___ the form. (COMPLETED)
activities.explanation: The key word supplies the past participle after «had».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: I last used the old timetable in January. I have not used it ___ January. (SINCE)
activities.explanation: The last use provides the starting point «since January».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: The instructions were so confusing that I called the office. They were ___ instructions that I called the office. (SUCH)
activities.explanation: The adjective moves before the noun after «such».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: People believe that the old tunnel is unsafe. The old tunnel is ___ unsafe. (BELIEVED)
activities.explanation: The reporting passive uses «is believed to be unsafe».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: The brown trail is much harder than the short trail. The short trail is nowhere near ___ the brown trail. (DIFFICULT)
activities.explanation: «Much harder» is preserved by «nowhere near as difficult as».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: “I may need more time,” Jo said. Jo said that she ___ more time. (MIGHT)
activities.explanation: The possibility modal «may» changes to «might».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: Someone should replace the damaged sign. The damaged sign should ___. (REPLACED)
activities.explanation: The modal passive uses «should be replaced».

activities.instructions: Complete the second sentence using the key word.
activities.prompt: I regret not taking a copy of the receipt. I wish I ___ a copy of the receipt. (TAKEN)
activities.explanation: Past regret uses «wish I had taken».
